recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-style album cover featuring a clean-cut male vocalist in a studio portrait, set against a flat, saturated magenta background with bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed upward and to the left, creating a sense of optimism.
High-contrast color blocking between the magenta background and the teal/blue clothing.
Primary text anchored to the top edge, framing the subject's head.
coreInvariants: Flat, solid-color background with no gradient.
Subject wearing a dark V-neck sweater over a white collared shirt.
Tight, vertical typesetting for secondary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and white collar serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large top header, moves down to the secondary text on the left, and follows the subject's gaze back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area in the upper left quadrant occupied by secondary text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; high value contrast between the white collar and dark sweater.

characterSpecificRedesigns: O and D are highly elongated ovals
R has a short, straight leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Arched logo in bottom right corner
Thin black outlines on primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal aesthetic of the header.
Provides the necessary mid-century grotesque feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a 1960s male singer with styled brown hair, wearing a dark teal V-neck sweater and a crisp white collared shirt. He is looking up and away with a smile. The background is a solid, flat, vibrant magenta color with no textures or gradients.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, condensed sans-serif header with a thin black outline at the top. Add a secondary block of cyan-colored condensed text in the middle-left area, stacked vertically in four lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid magenta?
Is the header text white with a black outline?
Is the secondary text cyan and left-aligned?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white collar is bright and distinct.
Check that the cyan text is legible against the magenta.
Verify the condensed nature of all fonts used.
Confirm the subject is positioned in the lower right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Magenta Field + Condensed Sans-Serif Header + Cyan Stacked Subtitle
